question: How does one reach the Lord without doubt at death?
premises: Remember the Lord at all times.
Fight with mind and intellect offered to Him.
One reaches the Lord without doubt.
This holds not only in a stable state but even at death.
Constant cultivation of the Lord's nature causes remembrance at death.
inference: Constant remembrance and offering of action to the Lord leads to reaching Him, including at death.
uncertainties: The supplied text fuses mūla and commentary, so voice boundaries are not fully separable.
Some long compounds and editorial markers are obscure or corrupt.
The exact Kashmirian-recension wording and numbering are not independently verified here.
plain_english: Therefore, at all times remember Me and fight, with mind and intellect offered to Me; you will reach Me without doubt. This is not limited to a stable condition, but applies even at death, since constant cultivation of the Lord's nature brings remembrance of Him then.
